The regression now compares exactly against hash-verified pre-refinement source in the same runtime and checks final RNG state; a one-ULP mutation is rejected. Current/reference equality verified locally in two runtimes with different output hashes. Full Linux-hash cause remains unisolated; revised hosted test result pending. No simulator or numerical tolerance changed.

Original code identities available only through history still under review; full run files/checkpoints have no stable public locator. Restricted data qualification and promised bundle scope need final owner review.
Saved A/k present for all 520 evaluations, but accepted/excluded calibration counts and sample records not saved. K_hat is algebraically derived, not a saved independent fit record.

Uncommitted preparation requires owner review before committing. Resolve this approval gate with the reviewed scope before the owner commit; exact clean SHA and tag are checked by the validator. Actual publication is a separate external verification, never a prerequisite for preparing its candidate.
